dedupe_keys.name: hatirjheel lake 6 7 mw floating photovoltaic feasibility inputs

description: This deposit contains inputs and calculated potential for a proposed 6.7-megawatt floating photovoltaic installation on Hatirjheel Lake in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The Green University research collaborators combine Bangladesh Meteorological Department climate records, Meteonorm information, equipment specifications and electricity-demand context for a feasibility study. Mendeley version 2 provides two Excel workbooks free under CC BY 4.0, including a file described as eleven years of climate information. Exact calendar bounds and a common measurement interval are not established in the short repository description. Coverage is one proposed location, and PVsyst-derived production or financial estimates are not observations from an operating floating-solar plant. Those limitations require separate checking of local water conditions and installation assumptions. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing generation and investment scenarios for lake-based solar development. model-system-advisor-model-sam offers related project-level renewable-energy modelling. No workbook, PVsyst project or financial result was independently evaluated.
